description: Copy rules for the plugin's own texts (README, manifests, skills). Whitespace is collapsed, every span matching `allow` is removed, and the line fails a forbidden rule when `test` still matches what remains. This rejects known phrasings only; the LLM-graded evals and review are the enforcement of record.
